posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Pydro:

Shouldn't you be conventioning? How do you have time to post here?Also, how's it going? What kind of reception is the video game getting?

There are 5 milliseconds in between when I get to my hotel room and when I fall asleep. In those 5 milliseconds, I can post to the forum,  fix some bugs, and  check the weather for tomorrow.

It's going really well! Over a thousand people have tried the game and there's still a day to go. The response is overwhelmingly positive, which gives me all the feels. We're getting lots of useful feedback and suggestions. The main constructive criticism is that players familiar with Sentinels want it to go faster - skipping dialogs, faster animations, etc. And we're totally gonna let you do that =). The demo is slowed down a bit because at PAX we also have a lot of people brand new to Sentinels, and we have to try to teach them a little bit about the game in a very short amount of time.
